note: v-series: camera-angle view keys (view_keys.py VW-Yaw_L/R at 35 degrees, VW-Side_L/R at 90). The keys slide the eyes, irises, brows and the skin around them along the face so the eye shapes read as drawn anime shapes from the side. All knobs are view_keys.py VIEW values set through look_knobs.json 'view'; a look pass (apply_look) rebuilds the keys, no head rebuild.

In the three-quarter view, make the near eye wider.
In the three-quarter view, make the far eye (the one on the turned-away side) wider, using more of the space between the nose line and the face edge.
In the three-quarter view, make the far eye narrower.
In the three-quarter view, move the far eye toward the nose line (away from the face edge).
In the three-quarter view, move the far eye toward the face edge (away from the nose line).

Make the near eye's iris wider in the three-quarter view.
Make the near eye's iris narrower in the three-quarter view.
Make the far brow longer toward the face edge in the three-quarter view.
Make the far brow shorter in the three-quarter view.
